Simoni, M., Wilkes, M.D., Brown, S., Provis, J.L., Kinoshita, H., Hanein, T. (2022). Decarbonising the lime industry: State-of-the-art. Renewable and Sustainable Energy Reviews 168, 112765. doi:10.1016/j.rser.2022.112765.

Review paper (EU-27 data). Loaded: Table 2 for the five EU lime kiln types (PFRK, LRK, PRK, ASK, MFSK): efficiency range, CO2 factor per t CaO, electricity use per t CaO, output range, plus calcination/product temperatures from the text; hydrator electricity; Table 3 capture options (capture rate, GJ/tCO2, CAC range) and text CACs for MEA, direct separation (LEILAC), oxy-fuel, calcium looping; solar kiln efficiency; calcination-free routes as descriptions. NOT loaded: any fuel energy per t lime - the paper prints NO fuel SEC (it gives thermal efficiency against 1819.4 kJ/kg CaCO3 only; GJ/t was not derived because the molar-mass conversion is not printed); MCFC and SOFC (primary energy, concept cost), waste-fuel calorific values (other-values), Table 1 gas composition, flow figures. Traps: (1) Table 2 LRK efficiency 35-53% conflicts with the text value 18-25% on p.3 (text value in other-values); (2) every Table 3 capture number comes from CEMENT studies (Voldsund 2019, Gardarsdottir 2019, Fantini) applied conceptually to a PFRK, not lime-specific; (3) no price year for any CAC (publication year 2022 flagged); (4) Table 3 specific energy demand does not separate heat and electricity. Locator: journal page numbers (PDF page minus 1, because PDF page 1 is a repository cover sheet). The file is the White Rose published version (CC BY), not an accepted manuscript. No kiln capex or opex is printed.
